description: Filters that dynamically modify a collection list when resolved. Include filters are allowlists (only matching collections pass). Exclude filters are blocklists (matching collections are removed). When both are present for the same dimension, include is applied first, then exclude narrows further.

content_ratings_exclude.description: Exclude collections with any of these content ratings (OR logic). This is a metadata filter on the collection's declared content_rating field — it does not evaluate episode content.

exclude_distribution_ids.description: Always exclude collections with these distribution identifiers

enumDescriptions.eidr_id: EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry) — ISO 10528 for audiovisual content
enumDescriptions.gracenote_id: Gracenote TMS ID — industry standard for TV metadata
enumDescriptions.platform_channel_id: Stable channel identifier assigned by the platform named in the enclosing distribution's publisher_domain. Use as the portable fallback when no platform-specific identifier type exists; identity is the tuple (publisher_domain, value), so this type is only meaningful inside a distribution entry and MUST NOT appear in bare {type, value} contexts (distribution_ids sources, exclude filters). Use the platform's stable catalog identifier, not an EPG position number — hosts renumber lineups.
enumDescriptions.youtube_channel_handle: YouTube channel handle such as @example. Useful as a discovery alias; channel ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.youtube_channel_id: YouTube channel ID. Preferred canonical identifier for YouTube channels; handles and URLs are discovery aliases that should resolve to this when possible.
enumDescriptions.youtube_channel_url: YouTube channel URL such as https://www.youtube.com/@example or https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC.... Useful as a discovery alias; channel ID is preferred for canonical matching.
enumDescriptions.youtube_playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID (for series within a channel)

genre_taxonomy.description: Taxonomy for genre filter values. When present, genres_include and genres_exclude values are interpreted as taxonomy IDs.

enumDescriptions.amazon_genres: Amazon Fire TV / Freevee genre taxonomy
enumDescriptions.apple_genres: Apple App Store / Apple TV genre taxonomy
enumDescriptions.custom: Publisher-defined genre taxonomy with free-form values. Buyer and seller must negotiate the vocabulary out of band.
enumDescriptions.eidr: EIDR genre classification — ISO 10528 for audiovisual content identification
enumDescriptions.google_genres: Google Play / Google TV genre taxonomy
enumDescriptions.gracenote: Gracenote genre classification — entertainment metadata standard for TV, film, and music. Supports multi-level genre hierarchies; hierarchy-aware matching is the seller's responsibility.
enumDescriptions.iab_content_2.2: IAB Tech Lab Content Taxonomy 2.2 — previous version, still widely used. Maps to OpenRTB/AdCOM cattax=6.
enumDescriptions.iab_content_3.0: IAB Tech Lab Content Taxonomy 3.0 — industry standard for digital content classification. Maps to OpenRTB/AdCOM cattax=7.
enumDescriptions.roku: Roku Channel Store / Roku TV genre taxonomy

genre_taxonomy.title: Genre Taxonomy

genres_exclude.description: Exclude collections tagged with any of these genres (OR logic). Values are interpreted against genre_taxonomy when present.

genres_include.description: Include only collections with any of these genres (OR logic). Collections without genre metadata are excluded. Values are interpreted against genre_taxonomy when present.

items.description: What kind of content program a collection represents. Determines how installments should be interpreted by buyer agents.

enumDescriptions.channel: Continuously programmed audio or video stream, regardless of carriage or monetization model; installments are scheduled airings or programming blocks
enumDescriptions.event_series: Live event program; installments are individual event airings
enumDescriptions.publication: Print or newsletter title; installments are issues
enumDescriptions.rotation: DOOH scheduling container; installments are scheduling periods
enumDescriptions.series: TV or podcast program; installments are episodes
